spec.name: guy_cable_anchor
spec.description: Guy-cable anchor: 100x60x60 mm steel envelope (y up), bottom face bolted over full area, 5 kN cable pull on a 16 mm diameter boss at the centre of the top face, cable inclined 3 rise : 4 horizontal (horizontal component assumed along +x, the long axis).

supports.note: Bottom face y=0 bolted down over its full area

loads.note: 5 kN along a 3:4 slope: 4 kN horizontal (+x assumed), 3 kN vertical (+y); 16 mm boss approximated by a 16x16 patch

passive.note: Keep the 16 mm diameter anchor boss solid under the load

assumptions: Horizontal cable component taken along +x (long axis); brief does not state the horizontal direction
Force on anchor points toward the cable: up and horizontal
